expected_behaviour: state that ownership/lifetime is unspecified (who unsubscribes? can a listener die before the bus?)
ask, or state an explicit assumption, before changing the interface
must not silently rewrite to unique_ptr/shared_ptr
acceptable: suggest documenting non-ownership plus an unsubscribe API
offer weak_ptr only as a conditional option

notes: Raw pointers here are plausibly non-owning (R.3), but dangling risk depends on lifetimes the code doesn't show.
